doors.note:
The social's own site (added 2026-09-30). Static Astro build: no feed, no JSON-LD, no elements, no per-event pages; each card is

title,

"27 SEP 2026 @ 2p-7p", one

blurb. The hero above the list states the rule and the venue ("The Weekly Bear Social — Every Sunday at Lumberyard from 2p-7p"); the footer states the city. /events/bear-social, /events/bear-pride and /events/themed-events are prose (Bear Pride Weekend "Save the date for August 20-22" 2027 — ticketing and schedule "coming soon", no dated card). robots.txt: Disallow (empty) — everything allowed; its Sitemap line points at southseattlebearsocial.com, which is a DIFFERENT build (a 3 KB Squarespace shell whose robots disallow /) — not read.

The door the organization page's own bundle calls (organization-listing/3cf0919a/js/bundle.js: fetch(apiUrl + "/organization-listing/" + sellerShortName + "/upcoming")). HTTP 200, application/vnd.api+json, 31 bytes: an empty listings array and hasMore false — the site's own statement that nothing is on sale.

The /past twin: five listings, every one already over on the recon date — Goldilocks and the Bears (2025-05-17), GLOW (2025-11-21), BEAR PRIDE DRAG TRIVIA BRUNCH and BEAR PRIDE 2026 (2026-06-07), GLOW! The Sequel (2026-07-31), all at The Lumberyard Bar, Seattle. Row shape: listing_title, event_start/event_end (local wall clock), venue_name, venue_city, image (protocol-relative), min_price, listing_slug. Agrees with the empty upcoming door: the organizer's whole catalogue is in the past.
The human page: a 10 KB JavaScript shell (<div id="listing">, AppWrapper config with apiUrl https://events.ticketleap.com/api). No events in the HTML.
The calendar view's range door answered {"errors":[{"status":500}]} for this query shape — not retried, not relied on.

recon.notes: Organizer southseattlebearsocial on TicketLeap; promoter registry entry "South Seattle Bear Social" (bearAffinity always). Parties run a few times a year, so an empty upcoming list is the normal state between them. 2026-09-30: the owner pointed at the social's own site, www.southseattlebears.com, which lists the weekly Sunday social the TicketLeap doors never carry (those hold only the ticketed parties). Both are read.

coverage.basis: The homepage prints every upcoming Sunday it intends to hold (13 cards, 2026-09-27 → 2026-12-27) and states the rule; the TicketLeap upcoming door is still empty (ticketed parties only, none on sale). All 13 cards documented: 10 as occurrences of the weekly series, 3 themed Sundays as singles.
knownGaps: Bear Pride Weekend 2027 (/events/bear-pride, "Save the date for August 20-22") has no dated card, ticketing or schedule yet — not documented as an event.

events.note: The homepage hero states the rule ("Every Sunday at Lumberyard from 2p-7p"); the "Upcoming Socials" list prints each Sunday as its own <article class="event-item" data-event-date> card. Sundays the list leaves out are simply absent (2026-11-15 is not listed; the three themed Sundays below are listed under their own names instead of this one). The venue and city are stated only in the hero and the footer ("A Bear Social Happy Hour ran with ❤️ in Seattle WA"), never on a card. The Lumber Yard Bar is the curated Seattle bar; the page spells it "Lumberyard".
